text:
maria: Quick heads up - I noticed the onboarding sample app README has multiple outdated auth & SDK snippets; new users copying them are hitting 401s and silent failures.

josh: which snippets exactly? can you paste an excerpt?

maria: file: examples/onboarding/README.md. The curl example still uses `-H 'x-api-key: $REDWOOD_KEY'` and the JS snippet calls `client.setApiKey(KEY)` which was removed in v0.9.

maria: broken curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

maria: current JS snippet: `const client = new RedwoodClient(); client.setApiKey(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);` -> fails with latest SDK (needs `new RedwoodClient({ token: ... })`).

tara: sigh, classic snippet drift. we should update all three canonical snippets (curl/js/python) and add a smoke test in CI that runs the curl example against a sandbox endpoint. also mention canonical env var name.

ken: also note SDK parity — python example currently uses `Redwood(api_key=...)` while the new JS surface is `new RedwoodClient({ token: ... })`. README should show the same conceptual parameter name and reference `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var everywhere.

sam: I'll open a quick PR. Plan: replace curl header with `-H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY'`, update JS to `const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });`, unify python to `client = Redwood(token=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))`, and add a short retry note.

maria: can we also explicitly call out that the SDK does automatic retries for 5xx and transient networking, so app authors don't double-retry unintentionally? copy/paste helpers are causing double retries in a few reported incidents.

josh: +1. Suggest a tiny admonition block in the README: "The SDK performs exponential backoff for server errors by default. If you implement app-level retries, ensure requests are idempotent and limit app retries to 2 attempts."

sam: PR #412 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/412 — includes README edits, curl/js/python snippet updates, and a GitHub Action that executes the curl example using sandbox creds (no production tokens).

devex-bot: Created follow-up issue DOC-1453 and lint task: check README snippets against current SDK API surface.

tara: can we add a docs-lint rule that flags removed method names like `setApiKey`? even a regex check would catch many regressions.

ken: regex + runnable snippet tests in CI sounds good and low-effort. also add a monthly scheduled job to exercise example apps.

maria: once sam's PR merges I'll run the onboarding walkthrough and update the quickstart templates to match. Also updating support KB to use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

sam: merging after smoke test. adding a note on token rotation in the README too.

josh: quick follow-up: update the onboarding ticket and support articles to mention the new env var name and the recommended retry behavior.

maria: filing doc ticket DOC-1453 for the KB & quickstart sync.

ken: thanks everyone. This should cut down a lot of copy/paste support tickets. Closing thread — ping if regressions show up. :thumbsup:
